phases.name_zh: 德軍入侵低地國與盟軍進入比利時

date_refs.quote: the immediate execution of Plan D
The German zero hour was fixed for 5.35 that morning
took up their positions on the river on May the 11th
The Belgian plan was to fight a delaying action on the Albert Canal

phases.summary_zh: 1940-05-10 清晨，德軍越過比利時、荷蘭與盧森堡東界，並以空襲與空降部隊打擊低地國。同日盟軍啟動 D 計畫，英法軍向比利時境內的代爾河一線推進，比利時軍在艾伯特運河與默茲河沿線遲滯德軍，待盟軍到位後退往該線左段。英軍先頭部隊於 5/11 起進入代爾河陣地。

summary_refs.quote: the immediate execution of Plan D
The German zero hour was fixed for 5.35 that morning
took up their positions on the river on May the 11th
The Belgian plan was to fight a delaying action on the Albert Canal

phases.name_zh: 默茲河突破與荷蘭投降

date_refs.quote: they had formed small bridgeheads on the western bank near Sedan and Dinant
determined the whole course of the campaign
gave orders to cease fire. In five days Holland had been conquered.
attacks were resumed along the whole British front

phases.summary_zh: 法軍原認為阿登山區不利大規模裝甲行動，德軍裝甲部隊卻在 5/12 夜至 5/13 於色當與迪南一帶渡過默茲河並建立橋頭堡，此一突破決定了整場戰役與英國遠征軍的後續走向。荷蘭在空降與裝甲部隊攻擊下，荷軍總司令於 5/14 下令停火。5/15 德軍續攻代爾河前線，但英軍所在的比利時平原並非德軍主攻方向。

summary_refs.quote: they had formed small bridgeheads on the western bank near Sedan and Dinant
determined the whole course of the campaign
gave orders to cease fire. In five days Holland had been conquered.
attacks were resumed along the whole British front

phases.name_zh: 盟軍自代爾河後撤至斯海爾德河（Escaut）一線

date_refs.quote: Night of 16th/17th Charleroi–Brussels–Willebroeck Canal
Night of 18th/19th The frontier defences to Maulde
By midnight on the 19th/20th the withdrawal was completed

phases.summary_zh: 因默茲河防線被突破，法軍統帥部於 5/16 命令第一集團軍、英國遠征軍與比利時軍後撤至 Escaut 一線，分夜依序退至森訥河線、登德爾河線，再至 Escaut 線。撤退在 5/19 至 5/20 午夜完成，英軍於 5/21 清晨前完成新的布防。

summary_refs.quote: Night of 18th/19th The frontier defences to Maulde
By midnight on the 19th/20th the withdrawal was completed

phases.name_zh: 德軍抵英吉利海峽、盟軍北翼被切斷

date_refs.quote: Now that we have reached the coast at Abbeville
When the German armour broke through to the coast at Abbeville on May the 20th
Monday, May the 20th, was for Lord Gort a day of manifold anxieties.

phases.summary_zh: 5/20 德軍裝甲部隊推進至索姆河口的阿布維爾，抵達海岸，將北面的盟軍集團與南方切開。德軍集團軍群日誌記下「包圍盟軍北部集團的可能性正在成形」。同日英軍在 Escaut 前線承受壓力，戈特勳爵認為英國內閣的指示無法照辦。

summary_refs.quote: Now that we have reached the coast at Abbeville
When the German armour broke through to the coast at Abbeville on May the 20th
Monday, May the 20th, was for Lord Gort a day of manifold anxieties.

phases.name_zh: 運河線防禦、阿拉斯反擊與海峽港口受圍

date_refs.quote: As the evening closed, both columns were ordered to withdraw.
stretching from Gravelines on the coast through St Omer, Béthune and La Bassée
halted on the line reached—Lens–Béthune–Aire–St Omer–Gravelines
On May the 25th the enemy could report that Boulogne was captured.

phases.summary_zh: 5/21 英軍在阿拉斯南面發動有限度的反擊，當晚即奉命撤回，未能守住所得之地。其後英國遠征軍縮短防線，以格拉沃利訥、聖奧梅爾、貝蒂訥至拉巴塞一線的運河線擋住德軍裝甲部隊的側後。5/24 德軍高層下令裝甲部隊在該線前停止，同時布洛涅、加萊受德軍圍攻：德軍 5/25 報稱布洛涅已陷，加萊仍在抵抗，戰鬥延至 5/26。

refs.quote: runs from Sedan in the south to Antwerp in the north
follows the Meuse through Givet and Dinant to the fortress of Namur
and from there runs behind canalised rivers to Antwerp and the sea

lines.note: 原文稱 'the line of the Dyle'；Wavre–Louvain 為代爾河段；那慕爾—Wavre 為 'Gembloux gap'（無河流屏障）。這是 5/10 起預定推進的目標線，英軍 5/11 起佔領其代爾河段（Ch. III p. 39），非 5/10 當日實際接觸線。

refs.quote: especially near Bergues, the enemy's attack on this day (31st May) was
On the 50th Division front between the frontier and Bulscamp
on the 3rd Division front near Furnes, and in the 4th
Division sector at Nieuport, the enemy attacked heavily

lines.note: 同段另寫 50 師防區始於 the frontier（法比邊界），不是城鎮，沒有當頂點。

refs.quote: The Belgian plan was to fight a delaying action on the Albert Canal from Antwerp to the Meuse and thence along the Meuse from Liége to Namur

lines.note: 出處寫「自安特衛普沿艾伯特運河到默茲河，再沿默茲河自列日到那慕爾」。運河中段的轉折點是為了畫出運河走向加的。這是比利時軍計畫中的遲滯線；出處同頁寫 5/10 清晨馬斯垂克以西的橋樑與埃本埃美爾要塞已失守。

refs.quote: the loss of Calais on Sunday evening
Calais had been in enemy hands since the previous evening
During the night they withdrew from Gravelines and the Aa
They had failed to take the town and had suffered heavily
Cassel was not seriously attacked on the 28th
hold Cassel till nightfall and then to withdraw
The move started at nine-thirty and leading troops soon encountered the enemy
held out in a 'keep' in the centre of the town
At about half pas six in the evening
at last overcame this stout-hearted garrison
Wormhoudt had become untenable
the garrison held out till night-time when, on orders to withdraw
they had to fight their way out and but a fraction of the battalions
the enemy succeeded in capturing and holding an undestroyed bridge
in the 4th Division sector at Nieuport, the enemy attacked heavily
There had been fighting all day at Nieuport
But the Coldstreamers counter-attacked, drove them back across the water
on the 3rd Division front near Furnes
on the 28th were established at La Panne in the Dunkirk bridgehead
During the night the eastern sector of the bridgehead was abandoned
about 6,000 men remaining at La Panne should march to Dunkirk
all their attempts to cross the canal at Bergues were frustrated
the 1st Loyals on their right withdrew from Bergues itself to the canal on the
after dark the British troops were all withdrawn behind the intermediate line
At Hoymille the attack penetrated the front held by a company of the 2nd
drove back the enemy and re-established the line on the canal bank
the only beach (Male les Bains) which now remained in our hands
the remaining French troops surrendered at nine o'clock that morning
surrendered only after holding out for four more days
